verdict.rationale: Cursor's documentation describes agent skills as portable, version-controlled packages that teach agents domain-specific tasks. Skills can bundle scripts, templates and references, are auto-discovered at startup, are invocable with `/` in Agent chat, and can be added alongside built-in managed skills. Custom subagents configured for domain-specific tasks reinforce the story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that custom skills work as documented.

support.subject: As a developer, I can equip the agent with custom skills to perform specialized tasks

citations.quote: A skill is a portable, version-controlled package that teaches agents how to perform domain-specific tasks.
Agent Skills is an open standard for extending AI agents with specialized capabilities
